<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex10032024-09-1111-36-00" status="reviewed">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Addition (158a7–158a8)"/>
         <lb n="158a7"/> ࿓|| 
         <l>lnga brgya pa rnams kyi <expan>thams cad</expan> mkhyen pa rtog ge ba rnams kyi spyi gtsug gi rgyan | </l>
         <l><rs type="deity">bde' bar gshegs pa</rs>'i bka' rab <choice><corr>'byams</corr><sic>'byam</sic></choice> dri ma med pa'i gsal byed |</l> 
         <l>rmongs pa rnams kyi long khrid pa bla ma rnams kyi gsung gi rtogs pa'i myu gus rgyud brlan pa |</l>
         <l>mtshan thos pa tsam gyis 'gro ba skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi don mdzad spyod pa |</l>
         <l>dpag du med pa'i don 'byung pa'i gzhi rgyal ba skyed par byed pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo rgyas 'bring gsum rtogs pa'i shes rab thun mong <choice><corr>ma</corr><sic>ba</sic></choice> yin pa dang ldan pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">bla ma</rs>s |</l>
         <l>dad pas rta la brtson 'grus <lb n="158a8"/> kyi lcag gis bskyod pa'i chos brgyad spangs pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa gnang ba'i dus su |</l>
         <l>gus pa dang dad pas gzhi bzung brtson 'grus dang shes rab kyis khyad par can gyi don la phyogs pa'i |</l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3863">shag kya'i dge slong gzhon nu byang chub</rs> kyis legs par mnyan pas |</l>
         <l>tshig dang don gyi rtogs pa phyin ci ma log pa mnyam pa med pa thob pa'i dge ba des skye bo kun yum la mos pa dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bdag</rs> nyid kyi rtogs pa brtan par 'byung par shog ||</l></seg></TEI>
